steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Hah... As I thought...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Bob! Y-you're bleeding!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We can't let you bleed for nothing! I can still—

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: No, that's enough.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Bob...

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: How much blood have we shed over the years?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Do you intend to continue?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Hmph. We fight for our survival, so why would we throw away our lives?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I admit defeat. I'm not strong enough.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Sorry, Mister Bob... But without this treasure, our village is doomed.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Step away from that chest. Give me the key.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: H-huh?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: The moment you unlock that chest, you will die.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: But I...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: This is something that we've safeguarded for generations. My father once said that taking care of this key was one of our most important duties—

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: —After you use that key, it will cut open your hand and drink your blood. If it comes in contact with someone not of the Kuranta bloodline, it will break.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Hand the key over to me!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: I can't... This key holds the future of everyone in the village.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Is that true, Skadi?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: The person who hid the Knight's Treasure took drastic measures in order to protect their secrets. Only—

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: —Only those who possess the true, dauntless bloodline of Kazimierz may open the path.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: 'Only those who fear not sacrifice and possess the true, dauntless bloodline of Kazimierz may open the path.'

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Although I knew I would have to make some sort of sacrifice to open the chest, I didn't expect it to be like this.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: But I've already made up my mind for the sake of everyone in the village. I must open this chest!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Grani, if something happens to me, please sell the treasure and distribute the money among the villagers!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: I'm sorry, father...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Carol, can I see that key real quick?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Um... sure.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: This key isn't that big, is it?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Even though it's not too big, the average person won't be able to survive losing this much blood.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: In other words, this monstrous key only sucks out a fixed amount of blood?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Carol,

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I'll open the chest.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Huh? But if you do that, Grani, you'll...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: It's okay.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Sorry, Carol.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hey Skadi, make sure to catch me if I pass out, all right?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Stop, Grani! Don't!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hnnf!!!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Grani!
A few days later
Clear \ Visibility: 12 km
Outside the bounty hunter camp

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: You bunch... How dare you show your faces here!

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: Assemble! Everyone, get over here!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What a pain. Why do I have to deal with these bounty hunters?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Well, we helped you find the key you wanted, so it's your turn to help me with my mission.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: As a matter of fact, if you were here earlier, we wouldn't have even needed to hire other people to help the villagers.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Tsk. Not my problem.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: There are quite a few of them. Considering you just recovered from... that... Are you sure you can handle them?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Isn't that why you're here?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Let's just get this over with. I'd like to get back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: All right, let's do this then!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Carol is waiting for us too!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Sorry, I wasn't able to help you after all...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: It's fine. The villagers would probably be shocked to see Infected around here...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: So, let's just keep this between us.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Anyway, thanks again.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I'm grateful for the decision you and Grani made...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Don't mention it!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: If we're all done here, then I'm going home.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hey, wait up!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Sorry, Carol! Let's head back to the village first. There are plenty of things we still need to do...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Also, Big Bob, make sure to take care of yourself! If you ever need treatment, remember to swing by Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Wait, kid!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Here, this coin is for you!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Oh!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I'll be sure to cherish this!
Months later...
(Letter from Big Bob)
Good day.
Bob here.
I'm writing this letter to you from a manor in the outskirts of Columbia.
We've all been doing well. Even though some problems never go away as the Infected, just being able to live with the sun shining upon our faces is more joy than we could ever have imagined.

Thanks to the kindness of Grani and a little girl named Carol, who decided to leave us with the remainder of the treasure after repairing their village, I was able to settle down peacefully with my brothers.
We already have everything we need to be self sufficient, and we're even planning to try growing hops.
This was all made possible by that Dewville treasure.
That, of course, is an entirely different story. Real interesting. But, I won't go into the details here.
I've also slightly changed my views about some things.
And I know that you've long held your own opinions about this too. Just know that Reunion is not the only place that the Infected can go.
I know you'll be able to make the decision that is right for you.
I miss you a lot. I hope that I will see you in Columbia one day.
Bob
To, Mudrock.
I'm glad to hear that.
